name: Yuuki Rio
source:
She is a bright, energetic and aggressive hafu. She is very attached to the main character and will play with him whenever she gets a chance.

She is able to deal with any difficulties in a positive manner and is willing to help those around her, making her "easy to get along with everyone.

[From [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/tun_fuwa/index.htm]official site[/url]]
